video_caption: A man with short brown hair and a beard, wearing an orange t-shirt, sits at a wooden desk with his hands clasped together, looking directly at the camera and speaking with an open, expressive mouth. On the desk are a gray mug, several small, colorful robot figurines in orange, yellow, and red, and a silver laptop covered in various stickers, including one for Google Search Console. Behind him, dark wooden shelves are filled with decorative objects like small statues, boxes, and books, while a dark curtain hangs to his right and two framed pictures, one featuring a wrench, adorn the wall. The scene then transitions to an animated graphic on a white background with a light-gray grid pattern. A light-gray briefcase icon with a blue strip and two white dots appears, which then transforms to show a browser window with a wrench icon inside, accompanied by the text "Google Search Console" and a blue rectangular banner below it that reads "Training." Finally, the banner disappears, and the title "Sitemaps in Search Console" appears in black text on the left, with a prominent blue vertical bar beside it.

A man with short brown hair and a beard, wearing an orange t-shirt, sits at a wooden desk facing the camera, speaking directly to the viewer. He has his hands clasped together on the desk. To his left, on the desk, are three small, colorful robot figurines (orange, white, and red), a gray mug, and a notebook. To his right, a silver laptop adorned with various stickers is visible. The background features a light gray wall with two black shelves holding an assortment of items, including a small white robot, a woven basket, books, and small decorative pots. On the wall to the right of the man, a framed picture depicting a wrench is hanging. At 0:04, a white rectangular text box with a blue outline appears to the left of the man, displaying the text "images - URL extension". This text changes at 0:06 to "videos - URL extension".

The video opens with a blurred shot of an older man with glasses, wearing a blue v-neck t-shirt, sitting at a wooden desk and looking directly at the camera while speaking. A silver laptop, a stack of books, some pens, and a white mug are visible on the desk. The background is a blurry office-like setting with framed pictures and a black lamp. The scene then transitions to a clear shot of a younger man with a beard, wearing an orange t-shirt, also sitting at a wooden desk and looking at the camera. He speaks, at one point pointing his right index finger upwards, and later clasps his hands together. On his desk, a silver laptop with various stickers on its lid, a gray mug, and several small colorful robot figurines are visible. Behind him, a dark wooden shelf with various items like books, boxes, and decorative objects is mounted on a light gray wall, and two framed pictures, one depicting a wrench, are hanging on the wall beside a dark curtain.

In a well-lit indoor setting, a man with short brown hair and a beard, wearing a bright orange t-shirt, sits at a wooden desk, speaking directly to the camera with his hands clasped in front of him. Behind him, a grey wall features black floating shelves adorned with books, decorative items, and a grey sweater hanging on a hook. To his right, a grey curtain is visible, along with two framed pictures, one depicting a wrench. On the desk, to his left, are some small colorful robot figurines, a grey mug, and what appears to be a small pile of notebooks or books. A laptop with various stickers on its lid is positioned on the desk to his right. From 0:08, a white rectangular box slides into view on the left side of the screen, displaying text that changes dynamically. Initially, it reads: "A sitemap might be especially helpful if:". This is followed by bullet points appearing one by one as the man speaks: "• your site is really large", then "• your pages are isolated", and finally "• your site is new / changes quickly". The man maintains eye contact with the camera throughout, conveying information with a clear and engaging expression. At 0:31, the white text box slides out of view, returning the focus entirely to the speaker.

The video begins with a man with short brown hair and a beard, wearing an orange t-shirt, sitting at a wooden desk with his hands clasped, looking directly at the camera and talking. On the desk are three colorful robot figurines (orange, white, and yellow), a grey mug, and a silver laptop. The background features grey shelves holding various objects, a grey jacket hanging on a hook, and two framed pictures on the wall, one of which depicts a wrench. At the 0:03 mark, the scene transitions to a different man with short grey hair and glasses, wearing a blue t-shirt, sitting at a wooden desk. He has a thoughtful expression, with his right hand resting on his chin, looking towards the camera. On his desk are a blue book, yellow sticky notes, pens, a closed silver laptop, and a white mug. The background is a blurred office-like setting with a brick wall, framed pictures, and a lamp.

The video segment opens with a blurry shot of a man, which quickly resolves into a clear view. The man, with short hair and a neatly trimmed beard, is wearing an orange short-sleeved t-shirt and sitting at a light-colored wooden desk. He makes a gesture by pointing his right index finger to his temple and then clasps his hands together in front of him as he speaks, maintaining a friendly and engaged expression. On the desk to his left, there's a grey mug and several small, colorful 3D-printed robots (orange, grey, white, and red). To his right, an open silver laptop with a sticker on its lid is visible. The background features a dark grey wall with dark grey curtains on the right. On the left side of the wall, two black shelves hold books, a plant, a silver bowl, and a brown box. On the right, two black-framed pictures adorn the wall; one prominently displays a black wrench against a white background. At the 00:58 mark, a blue rectangular overlay appears at the bottom of the screen with white text that reads "Check it out" on the left and "Links in the description below" on the right. The man continues to smile and look at the camera until the segment ends.

A bearded man in an orange t-shirt sits at a wooden desk, looking directly at the camera with his hands clasped in front of him, as if presenting. To his left, on the desk, are a grey mug and several small, colorful 3D-printed robots in orange, yellow, white, and grey. To his right, an open laptop adorned with various stickers sits on the desk. Behind him, a grey wall features two dark wooden shelves filled with items like books, a small basket, decorative objects, and a wooden box. On the wall to his right, two framed pictures are visible, one clearly displaying a black wrench on a white background, while a dark curtain hangs further right. A grey garment hangs on a hook on the wall to his left, with a small round table also partially visible in the bottom left.

The video opens with a pixelated view that quickly transitions into a clear, high-resolution display of the Google Search Console interface. The screen shows the "Sitemaps" report, highlighted in the left-hand navigation menu. The main content area features an "Add a new sitemap" section with an input field labeled "https://www.example.com/ Enter sitemap URL" and a "SUBMIT" button. Below this, there's a "Submitted sitemaps" table with columns for "Sitemap," "Type," "Submitted," "Last read," "Status," and "Discovered URLs." A single entry is visible: "sitemap.xml" (Sitemap URL), "XML" (Type), "Jun 20, 2020" (Submitted date), "Jun 19, 2020" (Last read date), "Success" (Status), and "287" (Discovered URLs). The video slightly zooms in on this "Submitted sitemaps" section, emphasizing the details of the submitted sitemap.

The video segment opens with a view of the Google Search Console interface, specifically displaying the "Coverage" report for "/sitemap.xml" on the website "https://amir.rachum.com". The navigation panel on the left highlights "Coverage" under the "Index" section. The main content area shows a summary with four cards: "Error 69 (2 issues)" in red, "Valid with warning 0 (No issues)" in orange, "Valid 73" in green, and "Excluded 115" in gray. Below this, a bar chart titled "Impressions" displays "Pages" over time, with red bars indicating errors from late 2019 to early 2020. The "Details" section lists two error statuses: "Submitted URL blocked by robots.txt" affecting 67 pages and "Submitted URL marked 'noindex'" affecting 2 pages, both with "Validation: Not Started" and a small red trend graph. At 00:12, the screen quickly transitions to the "Sitemaps" section, which is now highlighted in the left navigation. This new view presents an "Add a new sitemap" input field and a "Submitted sitemaps" table. The table shows one entry: "/sitemap.xml," submitted on "Jun 23, 2019," last read on "Jan 13, 2020," with a "Success" status and "267" discovered URLs. A small graph icon next to the "267" has a tooltip that reads "See index coverage," indicating it links to the previous report.

The video displays the Google Search Console interface on a computer screen, focusing on the "Sitemaps" section. Initially, the property "https://www.racham.com/" is selected, showing a submitted sitemap with a "Success" status and 287 discovered URLs. The view then changes to the property "online-behavior.com", where a sitemap named "http://online-behavior.com/sitemap.xml" is listed with a "Couldn't fetch" status and 609 discovered URLs. When this sitemap row is clicked, the screen transitions to a detailed error page for "http://online-behavior.com/sitemap.xml". A prominent red error message reads "Sitemap could not be read", followed by "General HTTP error". Further details explain: "We encountered an error while trying to access your Sitemap. Please ensure your Sitemap follows our guidelines and can be accessed at the location you provided and then resubmit. Examples HTTP Error: 404" (This text instructs the user that Google couldn't access their sitemap and suggests checking the sitemap's location and adherence to guidelines before resubmitting, providing a 404 HTTP error as an example of the issue). The interface maintains a clean, modern design with a white background and a left-hand navigation panel.

The video segment opens on a Google Search Console interface, specifically in the "Sitemaps" section. A popup window titled "Submitting Sitemap" appears with a loading bar, indicating a process in progress. Below the title, the text "https://online-behavior.com/rss.xml" is visible in an input field next to a "SUBMIT" button. Shortly after, the popup updates to "Sitemap submitted successfully" with the additional message "Google will periodically process it and look for changes. You will be notified if anything goes wrong with it in the future." followed by a "GOT IT" button. The popup then disappears, revealing the "Submitted sitemaps" table. The first entry in the table, corresponding to the recently submitted sitemap, shows "Submitted: Jan 20, 2020," "Last read: Couldn't fetch," and "Discovered URLs: 0." A cursor hovers over the "Submitted" and "Last read" columns for this entry, which is displayed in red text, indicating an error. The remaining two entries in the table also show "Couldn't fetch" in red text.

A man in an orange t-shirt sits at a wooden desk, facing the camera with his hands clasped. On the desk, there is a grey mug, and several colorful robot figures (orange, white, yellow) to his left, while a silver laptop with stickers rests on his right. The background features dark shelves with various items and a framed picture of a wrench on the wall. At 00:09, text appears on the screen in a blue box at the bottom: "Subscribe YouTube.com/GoogleWebmasters," prompting viewers to subscribe to the YouTube channel. The scene then transitions to an animated white background with a grey grid at 00:27, where a grey toolbox icon with a blue browser window and a wrench emerges. Below it, the text "Google Search Console Training" appears, signifying the title of the video series. At 00:31, the man is again visible, now standing behind the desk and looking at a globe. Several colorful robot figures are placed around the globe, including an orange one on top of North America. The man gestures towards the globe and robots with both hands, his mouth open as if speaking or reacting to them.
